verdict.rationale: Grok Bot has no documented 'project' or 'space' feature. Its closest equivalent is the named Bot: it keeps its own memory, files and preferences across sessions, is set up by describing its job (effectively standing instructions), and can be duplicated per scope. Group chats and Team Bot channels also share context, and a month-long user says each bot owning its own context and domain works well. missing for 10: an explicit project/space container that groups multiple chats and files, documented project-level shared instructions separate from a single Bot, and the ability to organize existing chats into such a grouping.
